title: Group Room Blocks Clause: Cut-Off Date Release
content:
**Clause 1 — Timing.** On Group Room Blocks, unreserved rooms are released only once the block's cut-off date has been reached. The release is made on the cut-off date itself, 0 days after it, counted in hotel local calendar days; rooms are still held for the whole of the day before.

**Clause 2 — Bookings after cut-off.** Attendees who book after cut-off pay the hotel's prevailing rate subject to availability, unless the block type honours the group rate after cut-off, in which case they receive the group rate while rooms remain.

**Clause 3 — Contract unchanged.** The release does not reduce the contracted room nights: attrition is still measured against the contract.

**Clause 4 — Lapse and cancellation.** When a tentative block lapses or a definite contract is cancelled, all room nights still held are released on that date with the cancellation basis.

**Clause 5 — Status.** Releases are recorded only for a block whose status is definite or cancelled.

**Retired wording, kept for the record.**
- "On the cut-off date every held room night not yet reserved by an attendee is released to general inventory when the block type releases all unreserved room nights;" — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis of the cut-off release.
- "the release equals the held room nights less the room nights reserved inside the block at that moment." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis of the cut-off release.

### Release timing (hypothetical cut-off date)

| Day | Unreserved rooms |
|---|---|
| The day before the cut-off date | still held for the whole day |
| The cut-off date | released on this day |

### After cut-off

| Block type honours the group rate after cut-off | Attendee booking after cut-off |
|---|---|
| Yes | receives the group rate while rooms remain |
| No | pays the hotel's prevailing rate, subject to availability |

superseded_clauses: On the cut-off date every held room night not yet reserved by an attendee is released to general inventory when cutoff_release_full is true;
the release equals held_room_nights less the room nights reserved inside the block at that moment.
